text: {"test_cases": 30, "summary": "Added a 30-case KUnit suite \"agent_test\" in lib/agent_kunit.c covering strcspn() empty/single-byte inputs, first/middle/last/absent reject positions, set semantics, NUL-terminator handling, high-bit bytes, exhaustive position and length sweeps, and cross-checks against strpbrk/strlen/strchr."}

{"test_cases": 15, "summary": "Wrote lib/agent_kunit.c with a 15-case KUnit suite \"agent_test\" for string_get_size covering zero/zero-blocksize inputs, byte values, 999/1000 and 1023/1024 divisor edges, significant-digit selection, decimal rounding and carry in both bases, block-size interaction, every unit suffix through Yi/Y plus the UNK overflow, the 2^32 pre-reduction, modifier flags, return lengths and buffer truncation, with all expected strings hand-verified against the algorithm since the sandbox blocked running a reference model."}
